text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, all eyes 
were on Daiwa Scarlet-san, not me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I shall stay true to myself! To 
become a true "princess" in my own eyes, I 
shall blow all of you away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure there are still people out there 
cheering for me...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this secret technique, I shall claim 
the throne of the strongest queen! 
Hyaaah~! Princess☆Dynamite!
